definitions.explanation: A period of time spanning years, emphasizing the accumulation or passage of time. Often used to express how time has passed or accumulated.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{年月|としつき}が{経|た}った。
{年月|としつき}が{経|た}つにつれて、{記憶|きおく}は{薄|うす}れていく。
examples.english: As the years pass, memories fade.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}は{年月|としつき}を{感|かん}じさせる。
examples.notes: 年月を感じさせる = to show signs of age

notes:
USAGE: {年月|としつき} emphasizes the passage or accumulation of time over years. It has a somewhat literary or reflective tone.

READINGS:
・{年月|としつき} - kun'yomi, more common in everyday speech
・{年月|ねんげつ} - on'yomi, more formal/literary

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{年月|としつき}が{経|た}つ (years pass)
・{長|なが}い{年月|としつき} (many years)
・{年月|としつき}を{経|へ}て (over the years)
・{年月|としつき}を{重|かさ}ねる (to accumulate years)
・{年月|としつき}を{感|かん}じる (to feel the passage of time)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{月日|つきひ} (days and months, time)
・{歳月|さいげつ} (years, time - literary)
・{時|とき}が{経|た}つ (time passes)
